current.text: Cleveland acquired Watson from Denver and gave up a first-round pick and money for him.
He is the projected starting forward next to James Harden, Donovan Mitchell, Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen.
He should be a locked-in starter at 30 or more minutes. His minutes floor and role look more stable than in Denver.
His usage should fall from 21% last season to about 19 or 20 next to Mitchell, Harden and Mobley.
He should block fewer shots with Mobley and Allen around him.
His upside depends mostly on injuries to others. His usage would rise if Harden, Mobley or Mitchell missed games, and his blocks would rise if Allen missed games.
Cleveland may close games with Mobley at center after adding Watson.
At his Yahoo rank of 120 he is a safe pick with upside.
He is one expert's best target on Cleveland because of his draft price. If he reaches 23% usage, he beats his draft spot.
He has no injury concerns now.
Cleveland plays 4, 3 and 2 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21, so the finals week has only two games.
Cleveland has the most back-to-backs in the league.

durable.text: Blocks are his best category. His steals are okay and he is not a great rebounder.
He is a good spot-up three-point shooter, especially from the corners. His 3P% rose every year, from just under 30% to 35% to 41%, and his FT% also rose every year.
The newest expert view is not convinced that his strong three-point shooting is real.
He handled a bigger role well in Denver when Nikola Jokic and others were out. His usage rose from 21% to 24% with Jokic, Christian Braun and Cam Johnson off the court.
He is rated a good defender.
He has only one really good season so far.
A significant hamstring injury ended his 2025-26 season early.

note: Watson costs only 1 to 2 USD (Yahoo rank 120, ESPN 105) and was not drafted in our league last season. That puts him near the end of a 144-player draft as a cheap starter with a minutes floor of 30 or more and blocks well above the pool (z +1.5). FT% (z -0.8) and assists are his weakest categories, but neither is flagged. A two-game finals week and the league's most back-to-backs cut into his playoff value. Early in the season, check whether his usage gets near 23%, whether his 41% three-point shooting holds, and whether his blocks drop next to Mobley and Allen.
